item.title: Viral AI startup Instinct has raised $350 million at a $2.5 billion valuation
item.description: The startup is only a year old but it has already generated a massive amount of hype (and money) while also spurring privacy concerns.

item.title: Amazon just tripled its order of Nvidia chips over ‘surging demand’
item.description: Amazon is adding another 2 million Nvidia GPU chips to its data centers over the next two years. But this extended partnerships stretches beyond buying more chips.

item.title: Anthropic continues compute-gobbling streak in $45B deal with Nscale
item.description: The new deal with the infrastructure provider is the latest example of Anthropic's white-hot compute-gobbling streak.

item.title: Google’s Gemini has a branding problem, and so does the rest of AI
item.description: Consumer AI apps need to stop making users learn their product architecture.

item.title: How do we explain OpenAI’s executive exodus?
item.description: Was Greg Brockman the right executive all along?

item.title: OpenAI releases its official report on the Hugging Face breach
item.description: The report, which spans several discrete cybersecurity compromises, is the most complete accounting of the incident to date.

item.title: Radar makes podcasts searchable — and usable by AI agents
item.description: Particle’s new podcast intelligence platform transcribes and analyzes more than 130,000 podcasts, making their conversations searchable on the web and accessible to AI agents through an API and MCP.

item.title: Ex-Meta scientists want to bring visual AI to the factory floor
item.description: Perceptron offers an AI model that it says can help machines navigate the world while also providing in-depth visual intelligence.

item.title: Bill Gates wants to see a robot tax and ‘Human Reserved’ jobs to mitigate harms from AI
item.description: Gates is mostly in the Responsible AI camp, but there are a few ideas in here we hadn't heard before.

item.title: Surprise: Z.ai is the AI lab behind the mysterious Ox Alpha model
item.description: Z.ai confirms it is behind Ox Alpha, the mysterious open AI model topping benchmarks and leaderboards, and its weights are set to be released soon.

item.title: Robot brain builders are pushing out of their GPT-2 era
item.description: Robot bodies are waiting for their AI brains to catch up.

item.title: QueryStory wants you to believe what AI is telling you
item.description: The startup came out of stealth with $6 million in seed funding and a plan to use LLMs and cybersecurity know-how to make AI queries coherent.

item.title: Arga Labs is building a better way to train enterprise AI agents
item.description: Arga has raised $10 million in a seed funding round that was led by General Catalyst, with participation from Box Group, Emergence, Gradient and SV Angel.

item.title: Hearing tech startup Legato emerges from stealth with $12M and a peek at its AI hearing glasses
item.description: The glasses, called Legato Frames, integrate the company’s patented hearing-assistance technology into the arms of eyewear frames.

item.title: Runable hits $21M to bet AI agents can go from building businesses to growing them
item.description: Runable says 60% to 70% of its 1 trillion-plus token usage in the last 90 days came from paying customers.

item.title: India’s Ringg gets backing from Peak XV as it pushes voice AI past the phone call
item.description: Ringg has raised $10 million from Peak XV as a part of its Series A extension.

item.title: Robotics startup Generalist reaches $3B valuation, sources say
item.description: The $200 million extension comes just months after the physical AI startup reached a $2 billion valuation.

item.title: OpenAI loses a top data center exec as stream of high-profile departures continues
item.description: In a statement to TechCrunch about Malone's departure, OpenAI said it had "recently reorganized" its "infrastructure organization to support the scale and pace of our work."

item.title: Stability AI, maker of image generator Stable Diffusion, raises $76 million in fresh funding
item.description: The company's new fundraising total now stands at $232 million.

item.title: Claude Cowork finally remembers what you told the app in chat
item.description: Anthropic is giving Claude a shared memory across chat and Cowork, so users no longer have to repeatedly brief the AI on projects, preferences, and other context.
